test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. It seems (A)/the I am themost(B)/ beautiful plant(C)/ in this forest(D).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in part **B**: "**the I am themost**".
 
• The phrase is grammatically incorrect and should be "**that I am the most**".
 
• "The" should be replaced with "that" to introduce the clause.
 
• "themost" should be two separate words: "the most".
 
• Thus, the correct phrase is "**that I am the most**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It seems **that I am the most** beautiful plant in this forest."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "It seems"** – This segment is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "beautiful plant"** – This segment is correct as a noun phrase.
 
• **D: "in this forest"** – This segment is correct as a prepositional phrase indicating location.
 
• **No error** – This would be chosen if there were no mistakes, but there is a clear error in part B.
